title: BARE: Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion for Humanoid Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.32642v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic obstacle avoidance is essential for safely deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments, where rapidly approaching objects require immediate evasive responses. Recent advances in reflexive evasion have focused primarily on quadrupeds, which typically rely on large-scale whole-body maneuvers. In contrast, humanoids can exploit their rich body articulation to evade through small, localized body adjustments. By moving threatened body regions without repositioning the entire body, these responses may require less execution time and less surrounding free space. However, local adjustments can alter mass distribution or support conditions, making it challenging to achieve rapid evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. To this end, we propose BARE (Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion), a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. translated_title: BARE：面向人形机器人的身体感知反射式闪避
translated_abstract: 动态避障对于人形机器人在真实环境中的安全部署至关重要，在这些环境中，快速接近的物体需要立即做出闪避响应。近期反射式闪避的研究进展主要集中在四足机器人上，这类机器人通常依赖于大规模的全身动作。相比之下，人形机器人可以利用其丰富的身体关节自由度，通过小幅度的局部身体调整来实现闪避。通过在不重新调整整个身体位置的情况下移动受威胁的身体部位，这类响应可能需要更少的执行时间和更少的周围自由空间。然而，局部调整可能会改变质量分布或支撑条件，这使得在保持全身稳定性的同时实现快速闪避变得具有挑战性。为此，我们提出了BARE（身体感知反射式闪避），这是一个由人类运动先验引导的人形机器人反射式闪避框架，能够在保持全身稳定性的同时实现快速的局部闪避。
tldr: 提出了BARE框架，利用人类运动先验引导人形机器人通过局部身体调整实现快速闪避，同时保持全身稳定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes BARE, a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability.
